propositions: git archive subprocess at llm/workflow/snapshot.py:181-187 has no timeout on Popen or communicate(), causing indefinite blocks on network stalls or lazy-fetch promisor delays
stderr=PIPE is never drained while stdout is consumed, causing classic deadlock if child writes >64KiB to stderr and blocks writing stdout
stdin is inherited instead of set to DEVNULL, allowing credential/host-key prompts to block the call
TimeoutExpired exceptions raised here can leak credential-bearing git command lines into error messages
Popen launch failures raise raw OSError instead of SnapshotError, breaking the module's documented contract
Child stderr containing transport URLs with credentials is interpolated into error messages unredacted on non-timeout failures
